import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int src, dst;
        long cap;
        long cost;
        Edge rev;
        Edge(int src, int dst, long cap, long cost) {
            this.src = src;
            this.dst = dst;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static class MinCostFlow {
        List<List<Edge>> adj;
        long minCost;
        long totalCost;
        long[] supply;
        long[] potential;
        long[] dist;
        Edge[] last;

        MinCostFlow(int n) {
            adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            minCost = 0;
            totalCost = 0;
            supply = new long[n];
            potential = new long[n];
            dist = new long[n];
            last = new Edge[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int src, int dst, long cap, long cost) {
            Edge e1 = new Edge(src, dst, cap, cost);
            Edge e2 = new Edge(dst, src, 0, -cost);
            e1.rev = e2;
            e2.rev = e1;
            adj.get(src).add(e1);
            adj.get(dst).add(e2);
        }

        boolean solve(int s, int t) {
            int n = adj.size();
            Arrays.fill(dist, Long.MAX_VALUE);
            dist[s] = 0;
            PriorityQueue<long[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> a[0]));
            pq.offer(new long[]{0, s});
            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                long[] cur = pq.poll();
                long ndist = cur[0], now = cur[1];
                if (ndist > dist[(int) now]) continue;
                for (Edge e : adj.get((int) now)) {
                    if (e.cap > 0) {
                        long newDist = dist[(int) now] + e.cost + potential[(int) now] - potential[e.dst];
                        if (dist[e.dst] > newDist) {
                            dist[e.dst] = newDist;
                            last[e.dst] = e;
                            pq.offer(new long[]{dist[e.dst], e.dst});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (dist[i] < Long.MAX_VALUE) {
                    potential[i] += dist[i];
                }
            }
            return dist[t] < Long.MAX_VALUE;
        }

        long minCostFlow(int s, int t, long flow) {
            long totalFlow = 0;
            while (flow > 0) {
                if (!solve(s, t)) break;
                long f = flow;
                for (Edge e = last[t]; e != null; e = last[e.src]) {
                    f = Math.min(f, e.cap);
                }
                for (Edge e = last[t]; e != null; e = last[e.src]) {
                    e.cap -= f;
                    e.rev.cap += f;
                }
                flow -= f;
                totalFlow += f;
                totalCost += f * potential[t];
            }
            return totalFlow;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int tlim = 105;
        int size = 6100;
        MinCostFlow mcf = new MinCostFlow(size);

        long[] supply = new long[size];

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int j = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            supply[j] += 1;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; t++) {
                int nu = u + n;
                int nv = v + n;
                for (int x = 0; x < k; x++) {
                    mcf.addEdge(u, nv, 1, c + d * (x * 2 + 1));
                    mcf.addEdge(v, nu, 1, c + d * (x * 2 + 1));
                }
                u = nu;
                v = nv;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; t++) {
                mcf.addEdge(t * n + i, (t + 1) * n + i, k, c);
            }
        }

        int dst = mcf.adj.size() - 1;
        mcf.supply[dst] -= k;

        int s = mcf.adj.size() - 2;
        int t = dst;

        for (int tIdx = 0; tIdx <= tlim; tIdx++) {
            mcf.addEdge(tIdx * n, dst, k, 0);
        }

        long totalFlow = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < supply.length; i++) {
            totalFlow += supply[i];
        }

        // Add supply edges
        for (int i = 0; i < supply.length; i++) {
            if (supply[i] > 0) {
                mcf.addEdge(s, i, supply[i], 0);
            } else if (supply[i] < 0) {
                mcf.addEdge(i, t, -supply[i], 0);
            }
        }

        long flowNeeded = totalFlow;
        long flow = mcf.minCostFlow(s, t, flowNeeded);
        System.out.println(mcf.totalCost);
    }
}
